lean.statement: For every complete finite-dimensional real-inner-product Borel space E, finite type iota, incoming probability law nu on E times E, xstar in E, h>=0, M>=0, if s maps to norm(s.1-xstar)^2+norm(s.2)^2 is nu-integrable with integral at most M, define a=exp(-h/2), sigma=sqrt(1-exp(-h)), mu=(nu.prod(stdGaussian E)).prod(Measure.pi(fun _ : iota => stdGaussian E)), X(w)=w.1.1.1, P0(w)=a*w.1.1.2+sigma*w.1.2, G_j(w)=w.2(j), and B=M+(1-exp(-h))*finrank_R(E). Then B>=0; X and P0 are measurable; w maps to norm(X(w)-xstar)^2+norm(P0(w))^2 is mu-integrable with integral at most B; and for every j, G_j is measurable and w maps to norm(G_j(w))^2 is mu-integrable with integral finrank_R(E).
approved_definition_context: stdGaussian E is Mathlib's standard Gaussian probability measure on E.
Measure.pi over a finite index type is the finite product probability measure.
finrank is the real dimension of E.
